# gateway — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
On-chain gateway. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl gateway <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

### gateway gas
Get current gas prices for a chain
`ocl gateway gas --chain <CHAIN>`

### gateway gas-limit
Estimate gas limit for a transaction
`ocl gateway gas-limit --from <FROM> --to <TO> --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--amount <AMOUNT>` — Transfer value in minimal units (default "0") (default 0)
- `--data <DATA>` — Encoded calldata (hex, for contract interactions)

### gateway simulate
Simulate a transaction (dry-run)
`ocl gateway simulate --from <FROM> --to <TO> --data <DATA> --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--amount <AMOUNT>` — Transfer value in minimal units (default 0)

### gateway broadcast
Broadcast a signed transaction
`ocl gateway broadcast --signed-tx <SIGNED_TX> --address <ADDRESS> --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--mev-protection` — Enable MEV protection (supported on Base and other EVM chains)

### gateway orders
Track broadcast order status
`ocl gateway orders --address <ADDRESS> --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--order-id <ORDER_ID>` — Specific order ID (from broadcast response)

### gateway chains
Get supported chains for gateway
`ocl gateway chains`
